name: HIV
tagline: Uvavanyo, unyango, alubonakali. Phila ubomi obupheleleyo.

what_is_it.heading: Intsholongwane kaGawulayo ngendlela ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: I-HIV imele i-Human Immunodeficiency Virus. Ihlasela isixokelelwano somzimba-ngokukodwa uhlobo lweseli emhlophe yegazi ebizwa ngokuba yi-CD4 seli.
paragraphs: Ngaphandle konyango, i-HIV inokuwenza buthathaka amajoni omzimba ekuhambeni kweminyaka de umzimba ungakwazi ukulwa nosulelo. Elo nqanaba liphambili libizwa ngokuba nguGawulayo. Ngonyango, i-HIV ihlala ilawulwa, amajoni omzimba ahlala omelele, kwaye abantu baphila ubomi obupheleleyo, obuqhelekileyo.
I-HIV ayisosigwebo sentambo kwakhona. EMzantsi Afrika, unyango lusimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente, kwaye abantu abaninzi abakunyango banokulindela ukuphila ubomi obude njengabanye abantu.

items.headline: 7.8 yezigidi
items.body: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaphila ne-HIV - ngaphezu kwalo naliphi na ilizwe ehlabathini.

items.headline: Mahala
items.body: Unyango lusimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente. Akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo.

items.headline: U = U
items.body: Ayinakubonwa ilingana ayinakudluliselwa. Kunyango olusebenzayo awukwazi ukuyidlulisela i-HIV.

items.headline: Iintsana ezingenayo i-HIV
items.body: Abasetyhini abakhulelweyo abakunyango banokuba neentsana ezingenayo i-HIV. I-PMTCT iyasebenza.

pull_quote.text: Uvavanyo kuphela kwendlela yokwazi isimo sakho. Iimpawu azinakukuxelela. Abantu abaninzi abane-HIV baziva bephile qete iminyaka.

signs.heading: Yintoni onokuyibona
signs.lede: I-HIV kaninzi ayinazimpawu kwaphela iminyaka. Yile nto eyenza kube yingozi-kwaye kutheni uvavanyo lubalulekile kunokulinda ukuziva ugula.

items.title: Iimpawu zokuqala (iiveki ezi-2-4 emva kokuba sesichengeni)
items.description: Umkhuhlane, umqala obuhlungu, amadlala adumbileyo entanyeni okanye emakhwapheni, ukudinwa, irhashalala, ukuqaqamba komzimba. Rhoqo uziva ngathi ngumkhuhlane kwaye uziphele ngokwawo.

items.title: Iimpawu zamva (ngaphandle konyango)
items.description: Ukosuleleka rhoqo, ukwehla kobunzima obungachazwanga, urhudo oluthe gqolo, ukubila ebusuku, amabala amhlophe emlonyeni, irhashalala eluswini elingapholiyo.

items.title: Inyaniso enyanisekileyo
items.description: Awunakwazi ukuba une-HIV kwindlela oziva ngayo. Zivavanye. Iyakhawuleza, isimahla, kwaye iyimfihlo.

spreads.heading: Yintoni esasaza i-HIV - kwaye yintoni engasasazekiyo
yes: Ukwabelana ngesondo okungakhuselekanga (kwilungu lobufazi, lomva, okanye ngomlomo)
Umama kumntwana ngexesha lokuzalwa okanye lokuncancisa (kuthintelwa ngonyango)
Ukudibana kwegazi ukuya egazini ngenxeba elivulekileyo
no: Ukwabelana ngokutya, iziselo, iipleyiti, okanye i-cutlery
Izindlu zangasese, amadama okuqubha, okanye iishawari

items.fact: Kunyango, abantu abane-HIV baphila ixesha elide njengaye nabani na ongomnye, basebenza, bakhulise iintsapho, kwaye bahambe ngokukhululekileyo.

items.myth: Ungayifumana i-HIV ngokusebenzisa iglasi okanye ngokuphuza.
items.fact: I-HIV ayisasazwa ngamathe, ukubila, okanye ngokudibana nje nje. Kuphela lulwelo oluthile lomzimba oluthwala intsholongwane.
Xa zisetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo ngalo lonke ixesha, iikhondom zisebenza kakhulu ekuthinteleni i-HIV.

items.myth: Abazali abane-HIV abanakuba nabantwana abangenayo i-HIV.
items.fact: Ngenkqubo ye-PMTCT, phantse lonke usana lunokuzalwa lungenayo i-HIV, nokuba umzali omnye okanye bobabini bane-HIV.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela
prevention.lede: UMzantsi Afrika unezona nkqubo zinamandla ehlabathini zothintelo lwe-HIV. Uninzi lwasimahla. Nantsi into esebenzayo.

items.title: Iikhondom
items.description: Sebenzisa ibe nye ngalo lonke ixesha. Ifumaneka simahla kwiikliniki, kwiikhemesti, nakwizikhululo zepetroli. Iikhondom zabasetyhini nazo zisimahla.

items.title: I-PrEP
items.description: Ipilisi yemihla ngemihla ethintela i-HIV. Isebenza kakhulu. Ifumaneka simahla kwiikliniki kubantu abasengozini enkulu.

items.title: I-PEP (kwiiyure ezingama-72)
items.description: Ukuba ucinga ukuba usandula ukubekwa esichengeni - yiya ekliniki kwiiyure ezingama-72. Iipilisi ezingxamisekileyo zinokunqanda i-HIV ekubeni ibambe.

items.title: Yazi imeko yakho
items.description: Vavanya rhoqo kwiinyanga ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-12 ukuba uyasabelana ngesondo. Izibini zinokuvavanya kunye. Iziphumo kwimizuzu eyi-15.

items.title: Ukuba ucinga ukuba uye wavezwa nje
items.description: Yiya ekliniki okanye kwigumbi likaxakeka kwiiyure ezingama-72 ucele i-PEP. Ngokukhawuleza kungcono - kwiiyure ezingama-24 kungcono.

items.title: Ukuba awukhange uvavanywe kunyaka ophelileyo
items.description: Zivavanye. Isimahla, iyakhawuleza, kwaye iyimfihlo. Akukho dinga lufunekayo kwiikliniki ezininzi. Thatha iqabane ukuba unako.

items.title: Ukuba ngaba uvavanyo luthi unayo
items.description: Qala unyango ngoko nangoko. Isimahla. Unyango lusebenza ngcono xa luqalwe kwangoko - akukho nzuzo ekulindeni.

items.title: Ukuba ukunyango
items.description: Thatha iyeza lakho yonke imihla, ngexesha elinye. Ungaze utsibe. Ukuba iziphumo ebezingalindelekanga ziyakukhathaza, thetha nekliniki yakho.

items.title: Ukuba ukhulelwe
items.description: Zivavanye kwangoko kangangoko. Ukuba unayo, inkqubo ye-PMTCT phantse isoloko ithintela ukosulela usana.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawubize, uye phi
get_help.lede: Akunyanzelekanga ukuba ucinge oku wedwa. Ezi nkonzo zisimahla, ziyimfihlo, kwaye ziyafumaneka ngoku.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla lwe-HIV
